SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_lines, count(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'

WITH x AS (SELECT f.sale_date, SUM(f.net_amount) n, SUM(f.quantity) u FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) AS n_days, sum(x.n) AS fact_net, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_net, sum(x.u) AS fact_units, sum(r.units_sold) AS rpt_units,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(x.n-r.net_sales_before_returns)>0.01 OR x.u<>r.units_sold) AS days_off
FROM x FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') r ON r.business_date=x.sale_date

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sold.sku, units_sold, COALESCE(units_returned,0) AS units_returned, units_sold-COALESCE(units_returned,0) AS net_units
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (sku) ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5
